name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.read.SpeechVoiceReadPaperOpenFailureActivity
description: If the built-in reader cannot open an article, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows a guide, copies the reading link, and opens the configured app so the user can paste the link into WeChat.
disableEffect: Blocking it removes the failed-open recovery path, preventing affected users from completing the ad-reading task and receiving its reward.
